name: MoonPhaseLoader
description: A loader where a shadow disc sweeps across a glowing moon, cycling crescent → new → crescent; optionally clipped to the moon for a crisp phase silhouette.
a11yNotes: Renders role="status" with an aria-label (default "Loading"); the moon itself is decorative and aria-hidden. Pure CSS animation that stops under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving a static crescent.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Seconds for one full cycle of phases.

propsApi.name: shadowColor
propsApi.description: Shadow disc color — match your background.

propsApi.name: clip
propsApi.description: Clip the shadow to the moon so only the lit shape shows.
